state:
Goal `tools-php-differences`: 10 of the chapter's 12 features are done. This session added `what-parses-but-behaves-differently`. `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists the 2 still owed: `the-tools-you-do-not-install` and `two-spellings-side-by-side`.
So far the proofs have corrected fourteen rows of `docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md`. This session rewrote two rows of § *What parses but behaves differently*: a `require` of a written path with no file is `E0311` at compile time and never a throw, and a pattern cannot ask for backtracking (`rule:core-classes/regex-two-tiers`).
Gap `nvs-ir/a-require-with-a-computed-path-runs-nothing` is new: `require $path;` compiles and runs nothing, whether the file exists or not. No proof carries its marker, because an attack on it passes.
Gap `nvs-types/a-never-method-that-reaches-its-end-returns`, gap `nvs-syntax/a-second-namespace-statement-in-one-file-compiles` and `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` are still open.
Each feature here owes one example, one attack and one case carrying `// covers:`. It owes no `about.md` or bench. `the-tools-you-do-not-install` also owes help: its section shows no code block.
A failed `float as int` throws `ArithmeticError`, which a `catch (RuntimeError …)` does not catch.
